title: World End Economica
synopsis: Roughly 16 years after the people who emigrated to the Moon had settled themselves. An age where a great number of people are chasing their wild dreams within the great skyscraper at humanity's frontier. A young boy named Hal, born and raised on the Moon, is one of those people chasing his wildest dream. His dream, is to stand where no man has before. In order to do so, he needed capital. A ludicrous amount of capital. The boy named Hal was facing a place that gathered up people's desires. Sometimes it granted them, and sometimes it crushed them mercilessly. There are only two key rules that govern that land. "The first rule, is to never take a loss. The second rule, is to never forget the first." Only those who followed these rules were able to obtain enormous wealth. The stock market. A place that has gathered crowds of persistent men and women for centuries. (Source: WEE Official)

title: Dalao Ni Tou You Diao Le
titleRomaji: Dalao Ni Tou You Diao Le
synopsis: As we all know, you can level up by killing monsters, and I am... that monster. As the only zombie on earth that can turn around and not die, I concealed my identity and kept a low profile as a zombie in order to protect myself. However, I was worried about my sick ex-girlfriend, so I secretly protected her. I didn't expect that my ex-girlfriend had become a female warrior who killed zombies without blinking an eye, and I was discovered by her? I wanted to escape, she wanted to chase me, we struggled and fell in love, and in the end you told me that the whole world had to die? Okay, I won't pretend anymore, I am actually a vaccine. (Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: Gakuen no Madonna no Watanabe-san ga, Naze ka Maishuu Yotei wo Kiitekuru @COMIC
titleRomaji: Gakuen no Madonna no Watanabe-san ga, Naze ka Maishuu Yotei wo Kiitekuru @COMIC
titleNative: 学園のマドンナの渡辺さんが、なぜか毎週予定を聞いてくる@COMIC
synopsis: Ryoichi Aikawa, an ordinary high school boy who’s crazy about fishing, helps the school’s Madonna, Misa Watanabe, when she’s being bothered by guys trying to pick her up by the seaside. After that, for some reason, Watanabe starts asking about his weekend plans every week and ends up making plans with him. Secretly meeting every weekend, the two slowly at an incredibly slow pace begin to close the distance between them…? A frustratingly sweet seaside romantic comedy featuring a single-minded, love-offensive JK and an unbelievably dense, iron-wall boy!
